g.text: ↑ root cause (why a small change became an outage):
logs share the disk with the data, with no size limit

text.tspan: disk full: Postgres cannot write WAL

g.text: (WAL: the journal Postgres must write to this same

text.tspan: GB disk before every change; no room → halt)
